task: Explore: SAT lower bounds for round-robin carry-over (league-schedule-generator flagship open item: 12 teams 136 vs floor 120)
errors: First version of eval/carryover-sat.py used a threading.Timer to interrupt the pysat solver; the solver holds the GIL so the limit never fired (runs went past 3000 s). Replaced with a child process killed at the limit; the child returns only true match variables so a large model cannot fill the pipe.
A `pkill -f '[h]ttp.server'` was refused by the hook because the pattern also appeared earlier in the same command line; the same call's heredoc never ran.

doc_friction.issue: league-schedule-generator next: says '12 teams 136 against 120' without saying 120 is the non-cyclic floor; Russell's (cyclic) n(n-1) is 132, so it took reading the README to know which bound was meant.
route printed '2493/40 runs toward the next review', which reads as a review long overdue but the router did not pick review; unclear what the counter means.

deviations.why: Explore is free choice; I took an open research-shaped item from a flagship's next: list (a proof question no heuristic could answer) rather than a new idea, since sweeps are saturated and the flagship asked for exactly this.
deviations.did: SAT encoding with python-sat (eval-only dependency, not vendored) plus a product change: the page now reports the proved least value.

goal: Answer or narrow the 12-team carry-over gap with an exact method.
notes: Explore idea: exact SAT search for low non-cyclic carry-over round robins (eval/carryover-sat.py, CaDiCaL via python-sat). Matches the known 6-team least (42) and 8-team floor (48). 10 teams: UNSAT at 80/82/84/86/88 (0.9 s to 1,302 s), so least is 90-94; runs at 90 and 92 stopped unanswered after 69 and 98 min. 12 teams: no answer at 120 (~65 min), 134 (~70 min) or 160 (240 s); SAT at 170 gave 166. Page report now says when the floor is unreachable (PROVEN_LEAST). Local: run_venture_tests.py league-schedule-generator ok (231 s); Chromium check of the 10-team report line, no page errors. No agent doc in docs/reports: README section and flagships next: carry the state. Not checked against the published carry-over optimisation literature.
